name: Towel Row
steps: Loop a towel around a sturdy post at chest height.
Hold one end in each hand and walk your feet forward.
Lean back with straight arms until the towel takes your weight.
Pull your chest towards the post, driving your elbows back.
Straighten your arms slowly to return to the leaning position.

name: Scapular Push-up
steps: Get into a push-up position with your arms straight.
Keep your elbows locked for the whole movement.
Let your chest sink as your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Move slowly and only travel a few centimetres each way.

name: Prone T Raise
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the ground.
Squeeze your shoulder blades and lift both arms off the floor.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your neck relaxed.
Lower your arms slowly back down.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back at the top.
Lower everything back down slowly and repeat.

name: Superman Hold
steps: Lie face down with your arms reaching forward.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold that position and breathe normally.
Keep your gaze down so your neck stays neutral.
Come back down once you cannot hold the shape.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
steps: Lie face down with your arms by your sides and your palms down.
Lift your hands a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead, keeping them off the ground.
Bring them back down the same path to your sides.
Move slowly and keep your chest lightly lifted.

name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Hold a band with both hands at shoulder width in front of your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders down.
Pull the band apart until your arms are out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Bring your hands back together slowly.

name: Banded Face Pull
steps: Anchor a band at head height and hold an end in each hand.
Step back until the band is under tension.
Pull your hands towards your face, splitting them apart.
Keep your elbows high and squeeze your upper back.
Return your arms forward under control.

name: Banded Row
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and a band around your feet.
Hold an end of the band in each hand with your arms out.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back until your hands reach your ribs.
Straighten your arms slowly against the band.

name: Banded Lat Pulldown
steps: Anchor a band above your head and kneel underneath it.
Hold an end of the band in each hand with your arms overhead.
Pull your shoulder blades down first.
Bring your hands down to shoulder level, opening your chest.
Let your arms rise back up slowly.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
steps: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Breathe out and round your back, tucking your chin and hips.
Breathe in and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Let your breathing set the pace.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step one foot forward into a deep lunge.
Put both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Drop your back hip towards the ground.
Open your chest and reach the inside arm up to the ceiling.
Come back down, swap legs and repeat.

name: Leg Swings
steps: Stand next to a wall and hold it with one hand.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg steady.
Swing the free leg forward and back in a relaxed arc.
Let the range grow a little with each swing.
Finish the reps and swap to the other leg.

name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel on the floor and sit back onto your heels.
Open your knees a little wider than your hips.
Walk your hands forward and rest your forehead on the floor.
Let your chest sink towards the ground.
Breathe slowly and hold the position.

name: Rowing Machine
steps: Sit on the rower, strap in your feet and grab the handle.
Start with your shins vertical and your arms straight.
Drive with your legs first, then lean back and pull the handle to your ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms, then torso, then legs.
Keep the stroke long and let the rhythm settle.

name: Ski Erg
steps: Stand in front of the ski erg and take a handle in each hand.
Reach up so your arms are almost straight overhead.
Hinge at the hips and pull both handles down past your thighs.
Use your core and lats, not just your arms.
Stand back up and reach overhead for the next pull.

name: Swim Bench
steps: Lie face down on the swim bench with your chest on the pad.
Take a handle in each hand with your arms reaching forward.
Pull one arm down and back as if you were swimming front crawl.
Let that arm return forward as the other one pulls.
Keep the strokes long and alternate without pausing.

name: Assisted Chest Dip (Kneeling)
steps: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Archer Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.

name: Weighted Push-up
steps: Get into a push-up position and have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep the plate steady without letting your hips sag.

name: Barbell Decline Wide-grip Press
arName: ضغط بالبار مائل للأسفل بقبضة واسعة
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell to your chest, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Crossover
steps: Adjust the cable pulleys to chest height.
Stand in the center of the cable machine with one foot in front of the other.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing down and your arms extended out to the sides.
Take a step forward, keeping your arms slightly bent.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.

name: Barbell Front Raise and Pullover
arName: رفع أمامي بالبار ثم بول أوفر
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and raise the barbell in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Next, lower the barbell behind your head, keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise the barbell back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
steps: Lie down on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Chest Tap Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.

name: Smith Bench Press
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar touches your chest.

name: Clap Push Up
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your core engaged.
Push through your palms explosively to propel your body off the ground.
While in mid-air, clap your hands together before landing back in the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Wide Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows slightly flared out.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest, then push it back up to the starting position.

name: Cable Incline Fly
steps: Adjust the cable machine to a low position and attach the handles.
Sit on an incline bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a controlled motion.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Pec Deck
steps: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat against the pad and your feet planted.
Set the handles so your upper arms sit level with your shoulders.
Grab both handles with a light bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring the handles together in front of you.
Open your arms back slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Incline Push-up
steps: Put your hands on a bench or a sturdy box, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge of the bench.
Keep your elbows at about forty-five degrees from your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Knee Push-up
steps: Kneel on the floor and put your hands under your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest towards the floor with your elbows tucked.
Stop when your chest is a fist away from the ground.
Push back up without letting your hips sag.

name: Wide Push-up
steps: Get into a push-up position with your hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Let your elbows flare out to the sides.
Push the floor away to return to the top.

name: Decline Push-up
steps: Put your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight and your core tight.
Lower your chest towards the floor.
Stop when your upper arms are level with your back.
Press back up until your arms lock out.

name: Typewriter Push-up
steps: Set up in a push-up position with your hands very wide.
Lower yourself towards one hand, bending that elbow and keeping the other arm straight.
Slide your chest across to the other hand, staying low.
Push back up on the far side.
Alternate the side you lower to on every rep.

name: Hindu Push-up
steps: Start with your hips high and your hands and feet on the floor.
Dive your chest down between your hands as you bend your arms.
Sweep forward and push your chest up towards the ceiling.
Straighten your arms with your hips low and your back arched.
Push your hips back up to the start and repeat.

name: Wall Push-up
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place your palms on it.
Set your hands slightly wider than your shoulders at chest height.
Keep your body straight and lean in by bending your elbows.
Bring your chest close to the wall.
Push yourself back until your arms are straight.

name: Seal Jack
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms straight out to the sides.
Jump your feet apart while you clap your hands in front of your chest.
Open your arms wide again as you jump your feet back together.
Keep your arms at shoulder height the whole time.
Repeat at a steady pace.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in a doorway and put a forearm on the frame.
Set your elbow at about shoulder height.
Step forward with the same-side foot until you feel the stretch.
Keep your chest open and your shoulder down.
Hold, then swap arms and repeat.

name: Machine Reverse Fly
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the plate in front of you until it reaches eye level.
Pause at the top without leaning back.
Lower the plate slowly back to your thighs.

name: Barbell One Arm Snatch
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the barbell upwards.
As the barbell reaches chest level, pull it upwards with your arm, keeping it close to your body.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and stand in the middle of the station.
Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, so the cables cross.
Hold your arms out in front of you with a slight bend in the elbows.
Pull your arms out and back until they line up with your shoulders.
Let your arms come back together in front of you slowly.

name: Lever Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at shoulder level.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells up to shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Weighted Arm Circles
steps: Stand tall holding a light weight plate or dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Keep your elbows straight and your shoulders down.
Draw small circles with your hands, slowly making them bigger.
Switch direction halfway through the set.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.

name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Raise the cable handle in front of you, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Continue lifting until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.

name: Smith Rear Delt Row
arName: تجديف الكتف الخلفي على جهاز سميث
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Shoulder Press
arName: ضغط الكتف جالساً على جهاز سميث
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.

name: Barbell Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it to shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder level.

name: Upright Row
steps: Stand up with a barbell in front of your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders pulled back.
Pull the bar straight up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height, no higher.
Lower the bar slowly back down to your thighs.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Sit in the lateral raise machine with the pads against your outer arms.
Set the seat so the pivot lines up with your shoulders.
Push your arms out and up until they reach shoulder height.
Keep your neck relaxed and your traps out of the movement.
Lower the pads slowly back to your sides.

name: Landmine Press
steps: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine holder or a corner.
Hold the loaded end at your shoulder with one hand, standing in a split stance.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Bring the bar back to your shoulder under control.

name: Pike Push-up
steps: Start on your hands and feet with your hips pushed up high.
Walk your feet in so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor.
Keep your hips high all the way down.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Feet-Elevated Pike Push-up
steps: Put your feet on a bench and walk your hands back towards it.
Push your hips up so your torso is almost vertical.
Lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Keep your elbows pointing back and slightly out.
Press up until your arms are locked out.

name: Handstand Push-up
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor.
Stop when the top of your head is just above the ground.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Wall Handstand Push-up
steps: Walk your feet up a wall until you are upside down with your chest facing it.
Set your hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the floor.
Keep your body tight against the wall.
Press back up to the starting position.

name: Wall Walk
steps: Lie face down with your feet against the base of a wall.
Push up and start walking your feet up the wall.
Walk your hands in towards the wall at the same time.
Go up until your chest is close to the wall.
Reverse the walk back down under control.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Stand or sit up tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Bring one straight arm across your chest.
Hook the other forearm under it and pull it closer.
Keep the shoulder down instead of shrugging it.
Hold the stretch, then change arms.

name: Battle Ropes
steps: Anchor the ropes and take an end in each hand.
Step back until the ropes are almost tight and bend your knees.
Sit into a quarter squat with your chest up.
Slam the ropes up and down alternately to make waves.
Keep your core braced and the waves going for the whole set.

name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a pulley high and stand side-on to it with your feet wide.
Grab the handle with both hands above the shoulder nearest the stack.
Keep your arms long and your core braced.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards the opposite knee, turning your hips and back foot.
Return the handle slowly to the top and switch sides after the set.

name: Smith Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench inside the Smith machine.
Roll the bar over your hips and place a pad under it.
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower your hips slowly.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, letting it hang down by your side.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend sideways at the waist towards the opposite side of the dumbbell, lowering the weight as far as you comfortably can.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
steps: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley and kneel down facing away from the machine.
Hold the rope handle with both hands and place it behind your head, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Keeping your hips stationary, flex your waist and crunch your torso down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell on your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your shoulder blades are off the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Rollerout
steps: Kneel on the floor and hold a barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Roll the barbell forward, extending your arms and keeping your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your knees, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and your knees bent.
Lift your feet off the floor until your thighs are vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.

name: Alternate Heel Touches
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulders off the ground and reach your right hand towards your right heel.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the left side, reaching your left hand towards your left heel.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Decline Sit-up
arName: جلوس من الاستلقاء مائل للأسفل بوزن إضافي
steps: Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight or medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your right side.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your left side.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and hold the sides behind your hips.
Lean back slightly and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Pull your knees towards your chest while bringing your torso forward.
Squeeze your abs when your knees and chest meet.
Extend your legs back out slowly without touching the floor.

name: Weighted Side Bend (On Stability Ball)
arName: ثني جانبي بوزن إضافي (على كرة التوازن)
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet shoulder-width apart and flat on the ground.
Hold a weight in one hand and place your other hand on your hip.
Engage your core and slowly bend sideways towards the weighted side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Get into the captain's chair with your forearms on the pads.
Let your legs hang straight with your back against the pad.
Lift both knees towards your chest without swinging.
Curl your hips up slightly at the top of the rep.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight again.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee as you extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a slow, controlled pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout.
